metadata.title: Medical-Musical Hybrid Studio Portrait
useCases: Editorial features on health and sound

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait featuring a subject interacting with medical and musical equipment, unified by a continuous EKG-style script header.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
the subject needs to be in a natural environment
modern digital interfaces are preferred over analog gear

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close studio portrait of a man with glasses on a stark white background. He wears a stethoscope connected to a vintage silver microphone. Above him, a thin red line mimics a heart rate monitor (EKG) and seamlessly transitions into cursive lettering across the top of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The stethoscope tubes frame the subject's face, leading the eye to the microphone.
The red EKG line at the top provides a horizontal anchor against the vertical subject.
The high-contrast relationship between the dark clothing and the white void background.
coreInvariants: Stark white background with no visible horizon line
Continuous red line integrating text and pulse waves
Subject wearing clear-framed glasses and dark, textured clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a medium shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vintage microphone in the lower-center foreground acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the EKG line at the top, follows the stethoscope tubes down to the microphone, and rests on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space in the upper third and around the subject's shoulders.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (EKG line, stethoscope details, skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, except for the sharp red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are formed from a single, continuous red line
The line begins and ends with EKG pulse waveforms
Uniform stroke weight throughout the entire graphic
Lowercase-style loops even for capital-height letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are minimized to keep the line horizontal
Connectors between words are extended to maintain the 'monitor' look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-weight monoline script used for all text elements to maintain the EKG metaphor.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the continuous flow and uniform thickness of the original lettering.
Matches the personal, handwritten feel of the line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with glasses and dark hair on a pure white background, wearing a dark jacket and holding a vintage silver microphone connected to a stethoscope around his neck.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a thin, continuous red line across the top margin that forms cursive text, beginning and ending with jagged EKG heart-rate monitor pulses.

verificationChecks: Does the red line connect all words continuously?
Are the EKG pulses present at the start and end of the line?
Is the microphone a vintage silver model?

adjustableVariables: Text content within the EKG line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Any brand logos on the microphone or clothing

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of the EKG line and lettering

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red line is a single, unbroken stroke.
Verify the subject is centered and looking at the camera.
Check that the microphone and stethoscope are visually linked.
Confirm the white background is blown out and featureless.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + White Backdrop + [Subject with Medical/Musical Prop] + [Continuous Red EKG Script Header]
